instruction: Configure Apache with DAVLockDB and DAV On
output:
<think>
This is asking us to configure Apache with DAVLockDB and DAV On.
Let me think through this step by step.
I'm piping because each stage transforms the data before passing it to the next.
I'll check the output to make sure it did what we expected.
</think>
echo 'Alias /webdav /var/www/webdav
<Directory /var/www/webdav>
    DAV On
    DAVLockDB /var/www/webdav/DAVLock
    Options Indexes
    AuthType Digest
    AuthName "WebDAV"
    AuthUserFile /etc/apache2/webdav.passwd
    Require valid-user
</Directory>' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf
